text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Vodka was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Something like this ain't no big deal at all, though.
Man, you're such a worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, if Trainer says so...
I'll... rest... but... jeez...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—HAHHH!?
Wh-What is this place...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! S-Someone!
Trainer! H-Hel—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm?
Wait a second, the thing floating over there is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What a wickeeeed cool bike!!!!
No way, it even has pitch-black wings on it...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, so awesome!! I've never seen anything like it!!
I wanna ride it, let's get on!!

(Toot-toot-a-loo-loo-loo...
Vroooom! Vroooooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, maaaan, so crazyyyy!!
I'm looking super freaking cool right nowww!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is this... a racetrack?
I see, so you want me to blow them away here, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoaaa!?
The bike's fender hit my leg...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhhh~!!
I'm gonna blow right past everyone with thissss!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wheeeew!
I'm so freaking cool—... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, here...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it was all a dream!
It was a super great dream, though~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm definitely gonna make this dream
come true one day!♪"
Having regained her form thanks to her dream, Vodka left the nurse's office in high spirits.

TWEEEEEEEEEEEEET!!
HEY YOUUUUUU!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you're under arrest on the spot for attempted driving without a license, disturbing the peace with that loud mouth, and generally being obnoxious.
By the way, no probation for you—you're going straight to the slammer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Scarlet!? Why!?
And aren't those charges totally made up!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "If you want to enter, you'll have to spell out 'Lady Scarlet, please forgive-pyoi' with your tail and broadcast it to the whole world!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That punishment is sooooo friggin' uncool!?!?
Noooo, if this is a dream, someone wake me up alreadyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: At least let me wear a cool orange prison jumpsuit～～～!!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, huh?Was that a dream...?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It was a dreeeeaaaaam...!
Thank goodness, for reeeeaaal...!

Because of a nightmare,
Vodka wasn't able to get enough rest.
